description: Hand-authored synthetic music and podcast catalog, a four-member family account with listening history, downloads, playlists and billing from Jan. 3 to Nov. 24, 2026, and a one-member account with a declined payment. Not a benchmark task.

sources.description: Original fictional text authored for this package by @byshail. All artists, albums, tracks, shows, episodes, people, devices and prices are invented; no external catalogs, recordings, show notes or listening data were collected, translated or adapted.

transformations: Listening sessions are expanded from hand-written weekly routines by dev/build-fixtures.cjs using fixed arithmetic (no randomness); episode progress, track play counts and auto-download/auto-delete outcomes are derived from those sessions and follow settings.
Clean versions copy their explicit track's title, artist, album and duration; track and episode sizes are computed from duration at fixed bit rates.
The second family (examples/task-data) reuses the same catalog with its own member, history and billing.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation, name collisions with real products and reuse permissions.
